item.title: 2023, Year in Review.
item.dc:creator: Luis Infante
item.content:encoded:
In 2023, Mintbase had a fantastic journey! We went all out to make everything easier and more enjoyable for everyone using our tech. And guess what? We marked an impressive 44% in June— that’s a whole lot of progress!

2022 marked the start of our journey with Mintbase Grants, and this year, we wrapped up the first round. Check out the pitches from our grantees and partners [here]. Now, we’re launching our second cohort! Some projects are already on board after the first 13 proposals. Got an idea? Submissions for the second cohort are still open here:

GitHub - Mintbase/Grants-Program: Apply for Grants to build on the Mintbase infrastructure.

Mintbase Wallet was the real game-changer this year, stepping up as the go-to hub for all kinds of projects. Picture it as this friendly bridge connecting your ideas to the real world, no more tricky onboardings.

In the same mission to welcome everyone to NFTs, we added stablecoins (USDC, USDT) and opened up Stripe connection. Now, even if you’re not into crypto, you can dive into the NFT world, connecting regular cash with the web3 universe.

minsta = Minting + Instant

Throughout the year, various projects launched their own Minsta, using Mintbase Wallet to simplify sign-ins. Minsta, an open-source app powered by Mintbase Technology, emerged as a modular platform to bring people together for diverse events. Explore more about Minsta here.

“With the upcoming excitement remember that crypto and ai are not binary choices. Build at the intersection” says Luis Freitas.

As the year unfolded we seized the power of AI to simplify the blockchain scene, rolling out Mintbase AI. Now, users can smoothly get on-chain info and run smart contracts, all with natural language. We teamed up with AI providers like OpenAI and Replicate, and for extra convenience, we dropped two cool plugins, “action” and “search” turning prompts into database queries and making on-chain transactions.

Try it here: https://ai.mintbase.xyz/

Thanks to everyone who built with us this year. As a little token of appreciation, we’ve made this drop, claim it!

Mintbase Drop

See you in 2024. We have big plans!

item.title: What’s new on Mintbase: November 2023
item.dc:creator: Carolin_Berlin
item.content:encoded:
TL;DR

  • Open Stripe
  • Mintbase Wallet Launch
  • Internal Hackathon
  • Mintbase Grants

Open Stripe

This month, we opened up our Stripe access for all of our users. After connecting your wallet to Mintbase, just go to <Manage>, then click <Stripe Connect>.

Mintbase Wallet Launch

We officially launched our Mintbase Wallet during NEARCON. The aim of our Wallet is to make crypto onboarding ridiculously easy for non- crypto natives. Go to https://wallet.mintbase.xyz/ to experience the gasless, seedphrase-less easy to use wallet.

Thanks to our new Wallet, we rose up in the ranks of Dappradar.

More on our activations during NEARCON here.

Internal Hackathon

After NEARCON, our team did an internal hackathon to leverage our technologies, dive into our infrastructure and validate our documentation.
Here’s a short wrap of the different projects that our engineers worked on:

Till worked on stripe2near, a project where you can include stripe into your NFT checkout with a single HTTP request. The user pays with credit card, but the seller receives crypto.

Rui Santiago worked on Blogchain, a decentralized writer’s blog. Blogchain allows users to create blogs as smart contracts and posts as NFTs.
Here is the github link and the preview link can be found here.

Luís Freitas created AI Chat, a minimal chat example that explores the concept of a unified AI API (Mintbase AI Router) and the use of Mintbase Credits for paying for AI chat completions. Check it out here.

Allen and Ruben worked on an AI image generator that lets you mint images instantly as NFTs. Find the link here.

Mintbase Grants

We are actively reviewing Grant applications. If you are a strong technical project, please apply via the github link below.

GitHub - Mintbase/Grants-Program: Apply for Grants to build on the Mintbase infrastructure.

item.dc:creator: Carolin_Berlin
item.content:encoded:
TL;DR

  • Open Source
  • Mintbase Wallet
  • Events

Open Source

This month we open sourced our audited contract factory and marketplace, responsible for deploying +1,500 NFT contracts on NEAR Team. This is the equivalent to the well known Open Zeppelin contract deployer. Developers are now able to quickly spin up their own contracts and NFT projects.

GitHub - Mintbase/mb-contracts

We also open sourced Minsta, a modular NFT photo engagement solution for events.

GitHub - Mintbase/minsta: Main Minsta Repo for new instances of Minsta

Mintbase Wallet

One of the biggest onboarding hurdles in web3 is the complexity of storing seedphrases and the need to own cryptocurrencies. The Mintbase Wallet which has been tested at several events, will be publicly released shortly.

The Wallet offers secure key management, frictionless transactions, and optional recovery features. More insights can be found in the recording below.

Events

This month we had several events with one startup challenge still ongoing until the 11th of October. Dive into the Mintbase SDK and earn a $1000 prize. Click here to find out more.

Encode x NEAR Horizon Hackathon

Our Head of Innovation Luís Freitas gave a workshop on Meta Transactions, AI and the Mintbase Wallet. If you missed his presentation, watch it here:

Event solutions: Minsta

We inofficially released our Mintbase Wallet during the Rakhi festival in India and it was a great success. Raksha Bandhan is a Hindu festival celebrating the unbreakable and special bonds between siblings by taking photos of gifted bracelets. Users were able to easily create a wallet and then mint photo memories on the Rakhi Minsta app. Over 49 new NEAR wallets were created and over 441 NFTs minted. The users were mostly non-crypto natives and were able to easily mint NFTs without owning any cryptocurrencies.

item.title: Celebrate, Connect, and Capture Moments with Mintbase Technology
item.dc:creator: Luis Infante
item.content:encoded:
In today’s fast-paced digital world, Minsta stands as a revolutionary app, powered by Mintbase Technology, transcending boundaries to bring people together through a versatile platform that can be tailored for any event. In this article, we’ll explore the core purpose of Minsta, its groundbreaking use case during Rakhi India 2023, and how it effortlessly integrates with the Mintbase Wallet.

The Purpose of Minsta:

Embracing Moments, Connecting Hearts

Minsta is more than just a mobile app; it’s a digital bridge that connects people in meaningful and memorable ways. It empowers users to capture and share precious moments, fostering a sense of togetherness, especially during cultural festivals like Rakhi India. Minsta’s intuitive interface and unique features facilitate genuine connections, preserving the essence of cherished traditions in the digital era.

The Grand Use Case:

Rakhi India 2023: A Blend of Tradition and Technology

To commemorate Raksha Bandhan, the cherished Indian festival where sisters tie Rakhi amulets on their brothers’ wrists, Minsta enables users to capture the moment by snapping a photo and instantly uploading it to the blockchain through the Mintbase Wallet.

The metadata is securely stored on Arweave, and a unique NFT is minted on the NEAR blockchain, making it easier than ever for non-blockchain users to engage with Web3 technology. The Rakhi India 2023 campaign was not just about sharing memories, participants can win prizes for sharing their NFTs on social media with #RakhisNEAR:

  • $250 -Top 10 participants on the campaign leaderboard will be rewarded with $25 in NEAR.
  • $150 -5 lucky winners will be rewarded with $30 in NEAR.
  • $150 -Best 3 NFTs are rewarded $75, $50, and $25 respectively in NEAR.

Quantifying Success & Simplifying User Onboarding:

Mintbase Wallet: A Seamless Path to Connection

In just six days, Rakhi Minsta achieved remarkable success with 49 new NEAR accounts created and a remarkable 441 mints. These numbers underscore the rapid adoption of Minsta and the pivotal role of the Mintbase Wallet, an integral part of the user experience. Streamlines onboarding, ensuring secure key management and seamless transactions. This integration simplified the process, making it effortless for users to participate in the festival campaign.

What’s Next for Mintbase Wallet:

Looking ahead, Mintbase Wallet is gearing up for some exciting updates:
Soon, users can effortlessly transfer funds, benefit from cloud backup for added security, import/export accounts for convenience, and even purchase and use credits within the app. These enhancements promise to make your Minsta and Mintbase Wallet experience even more seamless and user-friendly. Stay tuned for what’s coming next!

item.title: Simplifying Crypto Onboarding
item.dc:creator: Luis Infante
item.content:encoded:
At Mintbase, we’ve been rolling up our sleeves and diving into a common issue to make NEAR onboarding a breeze whenever we welcome new partners and collaborators into our ecosystem. While Blockchain continues to be a buzzword in the media public rollouts lag behind highlighting the need for an easy and safe way to handle digital assets. Frustratingly, prevailing crypto onboarding remains ensnared in regulation, security apprehensions, and ecosystem fragmentation.

In this article, we delve into these pressing challenges, sharing our journey to champion a superior onboarding solution for NEAR. The spotlight shines on FastAuth Wallet, a transformative advancement poised to redefine the NEAR onboarding landscape.

The path to establishing a NEAR account and navigating cryptographic keys can prove overwhelming for newcomers preventing them from fully immersing themselves in the world of NEAR and its possibilities. With Mintbase Wallet we want to simplify user onboarding with general benefits like secure key management, simple transactions, and optional recovery.

No crypto, no problem!

Diving into the NEAR crypto world is like being dropped into a new continent, and the crypto jargon can be a bit like a foreign language. At Mintbase, we have committed ourselves to breaking down these barriers and paving the way for widespread adoption. Our exploration delves into enabling users to kickstart transactions on the NEAR network, even without the need for upfront cryptocurrency ownership (NFTs before $NEAR).

We envision a future where web2 businesses seamlessly transition to blockchain solutions. No need for extensive user education around onboarding — just an effortless and seamless process. We believe this approach will entice numerous businesses to jump into NEAR, amplifying its reach and potential. As the crypto space continues to evolve, Mintbase remains at the forefront for innovation, driving towards a NEAR future that is accessible, user-friendly, and ripe with possibilities.
